description: Search journal articles, books and conference papers that UKRI grant holders reported as outcomes of their funded work. Returns title, authors, journal, publication date, DOI, PubMed id, ISSN and the GtR id of the project that produced it — the way to trace UK public research funding through to what it published.

query.description: Free text over publication titles and abstracts, e.g. "graphene battery".

search_field.description: Which field the query text is matched against. Default "all".
